Ongoing (the state changes as players rent horses)

Also known as the Horse Taming Quest. The horses in the stables can be rented, but sometimes they run away to roam with the wild horses and have to be rounded up again. While the horses are loose, {creature:Wild Horse|Wild Horses} appear around Thais' {wiki:Horse Station}, which you can tame with {item:Sugar Oat} to get the {wiki:War Horse} mount. When they are in the stable, the whole server (including Free accounts) can rent horses.
The horses from the stable can be rented, but sometimes they run away to join the wild horses and have to be rounded up.

While the horses are loose: tame a {creature:Wild Horse} near the Thais Horse Station with {item:Sugar Oat}.
Only {creature:Wild Horse|Wild Horses} can be tamed. Normal {creature:Horse|Horses} **cannot** be tamed.
Wild Horses appear every 3 hours counting from the server save, in groups of 0 to 3 — they may not appear at all. Bring plenty of {item:Sugar Oat}.
The {wiki:Horse Station} is east of Thais, west of Venore. The world change alternates between two states.
Depending on the current state, there are different things to do:
When enough players have rented horses at one of the stables.
Rent horses ({wiki:Rented Horse}). No loose horses appear, so you cannot tame Wild Horses.
Otherwise (not enough horses have been rented).
{creature:Horse|Horses} and {creature:Wild Horse|Wild Horses} appear around the Thais Horse Station: you can tame a Wild Horse.
For Wild Horses to exist, the horses have to be on the loose: while state 1 is active the horses do not appear outside the stable, so you need to **avoid** renting horses.

With the horses on the loose, go to the surroundings of the {wiki:Horse Station}, east of Thais. You go on foot: leave Thais **east** to the Horse Station ({coord:32442,32230,7}), where {npc:Palomino} is. The {creature:Wild Horse|Wild Horses} appear **every 3 hours** counting from the server save, in groups of 0 to 3 (there may be none).
In the area there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Troll|Trolls} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.
Use {item:Sugar Oat} on the Wild Horse until you tame it. Bring plenty.
It only works on Wild Horses; not on normal horses.
3. Putting the horses back in the stable
Lure the horses into the paddock

The state goes back to 1 (horses in the stable and renting available) when enough domestic horses are lured back to the paddock. Lure the {creature:Horse|Horses} that are roaming loose to the Horse Station paddock.
If nobody returns horses, the state also goes back by itself, but only after four or more days.

The Horse Station is out in the open, with nothing to keep you there: when you are done, walk **west** back to Thais. The Thais Horse Station and the Venore one ({coord:32848,32120,7}, with {npc:Appaloosa}) are linked by a carriage service between the two cities, but it **stops** while the horses are on the loose (state 2).
